newsitem.title: PANAMA: Six firms qualify to build Panama water plant.
newsitem.headline: Six firms qualify to build Panama water plant.

text.p: Six international firms have qualified to build a $30 million water treatment plant near Panama City, a top government official said Friday.
Alfredo Macia, head of the government's privatization program, said the companies were from Britain, France, Italy and Spain. He did not name them.
A public bid is scheduled for early next year.
The foreign firms qualified to build a 20 million-gallon-per-day water treatment plant to supply the Panama City metropolitan area with drinking water for 20 years.
The plant will be about 20 miles (32 km) from Panama City and sell the water to the government-run water department. No information was available on when construction would begin.
